title: Auto Shop — office case notes, salvage stock and rear-bay aftermath

actions.title: AUTO SHOP — FRONT DESK
pages:
Handwritten beneath the November first service slips:
Five visitors from Smokey's.
I heard the workshop doors slam.
The phone was already dead.
No service call was sent.
